# Kyle Daniel Gordon

> Kyle Daniel Gordon (also credited as Kyle Gordon) is an orchestrator, arranger and conductor based in Los Angeles. He was lead orchestrator on Rosalía's LUX (2025), recorded with the London Symphony Orchestra, and has worked in the music departments of Oppenheimer, Frozen II, Star Wars: The Last Jedi, Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, The Mandalorian and The Gilded Age. He is not the comedian and YouTuber Kyle Gordon ("Planet of the Bass").

## Key facts
- Lead orchestrator, Rosalía — LUX (Columbia, 2025), London Symphony Orchestra, conducted by Daníel Bjarnason, recorded at AIR Studios. LUX won six Latin Grammys including Album of the Year (2026); it has 10 nominations at the 69th Grammy Awards (Feb 7, 2027), including Album of the Year. Rosalía's official LUX credits list him as orchestrator on all 19 tracks.
- Film and TV: Oppenheimer (Ludwig Göransson), Frozen II, Star Wars: The Last Jedi (John Williams), Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, The Mandalorian, Haunted Mansion (Kris Bowers), Bridgerton, The Gilded Age (Harry & Rupert Gregson-Williams), Star Trek, Bluey and more.
- BBC Proms: lead orchestrator, Soul Revolution (2025), wrote its finale and played the Royal Albert Hall organ; arranger, Bond and Beyond (2026), played his arrangement of Radiohead's "Spectre" on the organ; arrangements for Marvin Gaye: Prince of Soul (2026).
- Composer: The Little Bird, premiered by the San Francisco Symphony (2026).
- Talks: speaker at PAN 2026, Instituto de Experimentación en Inteligencia Creativa (Universidad Torcuato Di Tella, Buenos Aires), "Creatividad en la Música", on orchestrating LUX (Nov 6, 2026).
- Records: Romani: The Untold Story (Billboard #1 Classical Album, 2024), Baby Shark 10th Anniversary and Bebefinn Medley (London Symphony Orchestra, conductor), Grace Kelly with Strings: At The Movies, David Friesen — This Light Has No Darkness, Mollie Elizabeth — People Pleaser, Alex Blair — My One And Only Love (arranger, conductor, producer), Jali Music — It’s Christmas Time (arranger).
- Orchestras: London Symphony Orchestra, New York Philharmonic, San Francisco Symphony, BBC Concert Orchestra, Seattle Symphony, National Arts Centre Orchestra.
- Education: University of North Texas (master's in music).
- Contact: kylegordonmusic@gmail.com, https://www.kyledanielgordon.com/contact/
- Press and interviews: kyledanielgordonpress@gmail.com
